slides.headline: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO After 33 Years

slides.stat_label: Colette Kress Steps In After Jensen Huang's Exit
bullets: She keeps her CFO role until a permanent CEO is named
Kress has been Nvidia's CFO since September 2013
Harvey C. Jones becomes Nvidia's first-ever board chair
Board will weigh internal and external candidates for CEO

slides.stat_label: Nvidia's Early Low After Huang Resigned, 12 Nov (US)
bullets: That is 14% below Wednesday's close of $173.73
Market value fell below $4 trillion in early trade
Recovered to about 5% down by 10:28 AM New York time
Nvidia is just over 6% of the S&P 500, which some Indian funds track
slides.credit_line: Sources: Yahoo Finance, The Hill, CNBC, CNN

slides.stat_label: Nvidia's Results Are Next. What It Has Not Said
bullets: Results at about 2:50 AM IST; investor call at 3:30 AM IST
Nvidia's release gives no reason for Huang's exit and no statement from him
On 8 Nov, the board said it was probing reports that he was a foreign-intelligence target
slides.credit_line: Sources: Nvidia announcement (12 Nov), Nvidia board statement (8 Nov)
